01 / ABOUT ARC

Built around your production.
Designed to keep it simple.

From raw material to finished exhaust, ARC brings each manufacturing stage into one connected process. Identify every part, check its quality, and make sure the right components come together.

Know every part

Unique serial numbers preserve a component’s identity through its entire journey.

Quality at every stage

Required inspections help keep failed components out of final output.

Connect with confidence

Parent–child checks verify compatibility before assembly begins.

02 / THE PROCESS

One clear path.
From first scan to final output.

Five connected stages.
A complete history for every component.

01→

Identify

Give every component a unique serial number.

02→

Test

Check for leakage and fire resistance.

03→

Inspect

Verify quality before moving forward.

04→

Assemble

Match the right parent and child components.

05→

Release

Verified products to warehouse.

When a part fails, it goes through repair and re-inspection before continuing.

03 / TRACEABILITY

The right components.
The right connection.

Assembly should never depend on a matching name alone. ARC checks unique serial numbers, inspection history, production orders, and existing assignments.

  • Verify parent and child inspection status
  • Prevent a component from being assigned twice
  • Block assembly when a required check fails
